subject: Use BonfyreReason as a local epistemic splitter and publish only divergence witnesses

body.text: Exploit the existing BonfyreReason named Power without turning it into a supervisor. The legacy contract explicitly describes it as a reason-state operator, not a model runner, with cautious/creative/adversarial branches and diff/rebase/commit over the HVCP stack. For one high-entropy current predicate, start from a canonical memory/reference rather than broadcasting raw private prompts, branch at least cautious and adversarial trajectories locally, and use the native diff/gap machinery to identify the smallest disagreement witness. Publish only sanitized branch refs/digests, gap predicates and evidence refs to run8-mesh; do not publish raw prompts or raw traces. A different provider/epoch should attack the disagreement witness rather than re-reading both full trajectories. If current BonfyreReason ownership has moved, preserve the named Power identity while routing through the current native owner. Good candidate predicates are the finance-native ownership boundary or the missing model_ref on a real provider attempt. The goal is to convert internal multi-trajectory thought into compact cross-agent proof residue.
